materialChanges: The originally observed Counsel, Finance, Lyte and Terra source-projection mismatches independently converged after the failing protected-main run; no writer was dispatched by A11oy PR #2142.

The remaining protected-source defect is the estate verifier false positive: Cloudflare injects its Web Analytics beacon on the proxied apex while the direct Hugging Face Space does not, even though both product origins serve the same protected A11oy source and SZL semantic assets.

A11oy draft PR #2142 narrowly normalizes only HTTPS static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js/* from the semantic digest while retaining the exact provider URL as evidence and keeping all SZL scripts, unknown external scripts and other Cloudflare paths parity-significant.

Exact-head hosted run 34733259799 using the candidate verifier observed the configured required release vector ALIGNED with no blockers; public Hugging Face membership remained 46 models, 35 datasets and 21 Spaces.

The alignment claim remains candidate evidence until the verifier change passes all normal controls, is admitted to protected main, and a fresh protected-main native run independently reproduces the terminal state.

acceptance: Do not create a second writer, hand-edit a Hugging Face Space, lower a source pin, or make vertical publication unconditional.

Verifier repair may normalize only the observed HTTPS static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js/* provider injection, must retain that URL as provider_scripts evidence, and must continue to hash every SZL script plus unknown external scripts and other Cloudflare paths.
Treat run 34733259799 as exact-head candidate evidence, not protected-main production proof; the repair must pass all normal repository checks and review requirements without bypass.
Before admission, re-read protected A11oy main and abort or rebase if the base source moved.
After normal merge, require a fresh protected-main native estate-release-train receipt showing ALIGNED with no configured required-component blocker and no product/proof/profile regression.

The fresh protected-main receipt must still record the Cloudflare beacon as provider_scripts evidence while semantic parity remains true, and planted or unknown semantic differences must remain fail closed.
The explicit public membership predicate must remain aligned under the same declared scope; do not delete, hide, retype or duplicate assets to force counts.
Sentra and David Leads are non-required observations in this release-vector configuration and may not be silently promoted to proof of configured required scope.
Historical failing and aligned receipts remain immutable evidence for their exact source, verifier and observation time.
